intro: A shimmering, mirror-like creature blocks your path.$Its formless surface ripples, reflecting your team back at you…
title: The Mega Mirror
description: The creature seems to be studying your Pokémon, searching for untapped potential. You sense that it wants to test your bond — by becoming the very power one of your Pokémon has yet to unlock.

1.label: Face the Reflection
1.tooltip:
(-) Fight a powerful Mega-Evolved Boss
(+) Earn its Mega Stone
1.selected: The creature's surface swirls violently…$It takes the shape of {{selectedPokemon}} — and erupts with Mega Energy!

2.label: Turn Away
2.selected: You avert your eyes from the mirror.$The creature ripples once, then melts back into the shadows.

invalidSelection: This Pokémon has no unclaimed Mega form.
outro: The shattered reflection dissolves into motes of light…$Something solid remains where it stood!
